blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — US President Donald Trump said Saturday he was ordering the Justice Department to examine Democratic threats to impeach members of his administration. Trump faces a radically transformed and hostile political landscape after Democrats seized both the House of Representatives and the Senate in Tuesday’s midterms. Democrats have vowed investigations into Trump and senior members of his administration, including Attorney General Todd Blanche and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. “The Democrats are going around threatening a lot of people,” Trump said in a post on his Truth Social platform. “This is extortion at the highest level, and they should […]...
